items.title: build(cmake): add /utf-8 MSVC compile option to fix builds on Chinese Windows
items.note:
## Summary

Add `add_compile_options(/utf-8)` under `if(MSVC)` in `CMakeLists.txt` so builds succeed reliably on non-UTF-8 Windows system locales — specifically Chinese versions of Windows (e.g., CP936 / GBK).

## Why

Without `/utf-8`, MSVC interprets source files using the active Windows ANSI code page instead of UTF-8.
